title: Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion Goldman Sachs' third-quarter 13F shows $1.28 billion in spot bitcoin ETFs at Sept. 30, up from about $580 million, led by a 52-fold jump in Fidelity's fund, while its Strategy stake fell about 52%. This post Goldman Sachs More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Holdings to $1.28 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
